trigger_condition: No FR says how the engine picks active vs quiet months, which event fires, or how age, flags and boomerang pairs gate selection.
guard_snippet: Add FR-17a Event scheduling: active/quiet month rule, eligibility (age, flags, already-seen), seeded random selection, boomerang delay range, no repeats, whether FR-24 expenses are events or automatic deductions.
potential_consequence: Architecture and stories each invent selection logic; 20-30 choices, 10-15 min sessions and FR-43 can't be designed or tested.

trigger_condition: Only the pengegave is drawn once and stored; other draws happen 'each time', so reloading gives a new draw.
guard_snippet: FR-12: every random draw made server-side once, stored before shown, reused on reload; per-playthrough seed. Test: reload shows same family-help result and expense.
potential_consequence: Players reroll until family says yes; determinism breaks across devices.

trigger_condition: FR-9 implies mid-game restart; FR-43 covers only play-again after the ending; old playthrough data rules missing.
guard_snippet: State whether abandoning before 20 is allowed (confirm, irreversible), one active playthrough, and retention of finished/abandoned playthroughs.
potential_consequence: Restart-scumming for a big pengegave or the licence gift; minors' game data piles up indefinitely.

trigger_condition: No loan cap, income requirement or terms: borrow ~NOK 100,000 in the last month, save it, win 'save for something big'.
guard_snippet: FR-25: max loan N x monthly wage, income requirement, allowed terms. FR-9: savings goals measured as net worth. Test: borrowing in month 59 can't turn a non-win into a win.
potential_consequence: Winning strategy is to borrow just before the end, teaching the opposite of the product's purpose.

trigger_condition: The three life goals have no measurable definition (which balances, family loans as debt, experience bought or held).
guard_snippet: Per goal, a formula evaluated at 20; experience goal states whether a purchase event marks it achieved; reference play pattern for 'reachable from NOK 10,000'.
potential_consequence: F9 ending tests can't be written; experience goal copies the savings goal or can't be won if bought at 19.

trigger_condition: Wellbeing has no scale, no combination rule, no final-vs-average rule; 'above/below' leaves equality uncovered.
guard_snippet: Define 0-100 score as weighted sum of (100 - stress), free time, social life; state final value or last-N average; 'at or above' for real win.
potential_consequence: F9 fails at the boundary; neglect wellbeing for 4.5 years and fix it at the end for a real win.

trigger_condition: A random expense in month 60 can push the account below 0 and give a loss with no crisis month left.
guard_snippet: No random expenses in the last N months, or a final crisis month before the ending, or loss conditions must persist 2+ months.
potential_consequence: Careful player gets a random loss; contradicts 'the game always shows why'.

trigger_condition: Crisis options have no rules: payment-plan terms undefined, nothing to sell, already at max hours, repeat cadence undefined.
guard_snippet: Payment-plan terms as config; show options only when possible; at least one always available; at most one crisis per N months per trigger.
potential_consequence: Every remaining month becomes a crisis; a crisis with no valid option leaves the player stuck.

trigger_condition: Triggers ignore liquid savings and seasonal income; negative balance under 18 and its interest undefined.
guard_snippet: Define the account model (current, savings, BSU, auto-draw), negative-balance interest, net-debt vs income for 3x, zero-income floor; worked examples.
potential_consequence: Solvent players and summer-job players get false crisis months every autumn.

trigger_condition: No mechanism for spending on the card or choosing the monthly payment; over-limit undefined; UJ-4 fuel on card vs FR-23 fixed cost.
guard_snippet: Options state payment method; player chooses full/minimum/custom with default; missed minimum doesn't also push account below 0; over-limit purchase rejected; limit rise rule.
potential_consequence: UJ-4 core loop can't be built; missed-minimum trigger unreachable or double-fires with below-zero.

trigger_condition: UJ-4 debt 'much larger than his monthly wage' and five months of shifts after the moped sale, but the limit is NOK 5,000-10,000 and the moped resells for ~NOK 10,000.
guard_snippet: Make numbers consistent (interest/limit increase, or smaller story) and add a month-by-month worked example of UJ-4.
potential_consequence: The flagship credit journey can't be reproduced by the engine as configured.

trigger_condition: Mobile and transport (~NOK 32,000 over 60 months) are deducted from 15 with no pocket money; a no-job player goes below 0 at ~16.5.
guard_snippet: State which fixed costs the player pays per age (e.g. parents pay until 18), or add pocket money; check FR-9 reachability against a no-job run.
potential_consequence: Cautious under-18 players fall into repeated crises; early game feels like punishment.

trigger_condition: How the player chooses hours is engine logic but is left to UX in OQ-9 and marked non-blocking; rule 10 needs school vs holiday weeks.
guard_snippet: Move the hours mechanism into an FR (persistent weekly hours, changed via events), define weekly-to-monthly conversion, mark OQ-9 blocking FR-20 and FR-33.
potential_consequence: Engine stories can't compute wages or free time; rule 10 enforcement untestable.

trigger_condition: No start month, birthday month or school calendar, but tax and BSU work per calendar year.
guard_snippet: Add a calendar definition (start month, birthday month, school year Aug-Jun, school-end months); replace 'about 19' with an exact month.
potential_consequence: Tax, BSU deduction, wage changes and hour limits differ by implementer; mid-year bugs go unnoticed.

trigger_condition: Only credit has an exact unlock age; summer job, part-time job, car licence and full-time job ages are vague.
guard_snippet: Table in FR-18: option -> unlock age and month with source rule; state whether the under-16 wage rate is used.
potential_consequence: Teaser, event author and engine disagree on when options open.

trigger_condition: No BSU yearly deposit cap and no withdrawal rule; BSU at 5.61% beats savings with no downside.
guard_snippet: Cap BSU deposits at NOK 27,500/year; define withdrawal (only for flat goal / blocked / reverses deduction); add a D-text.
potential_consequence: Best strategy is everything in BSU; the game teaches BSU is a better savings account.

trigger_condition: Config and events can change during playtests, but nothing ties a playthrough to its config/library version.
guard_snippet: NFR-4: each playthrough stores its config and event-library version; changes apply only to new playthroughs; cause links point to existing event versions.
potential_consequence: Retuning mid-playtest silently changes existing games and breaks FR-12 and F10.

trigger_condition: Compound effects have many causes; 'ranked by effect in kroner' has no baseline or sign.
guard_snippet: Define multi-cause attribution (e.g. pro rata), a choice's kroner effect, most-negative vs largest-absolute ranking, and fewer-than-three behaviour.
potential_consequence: 'Hvorfor?' points to an arbitrary purchase; top three may show helpful choices with 'avoid the problem' text.

trigger_condition: FR-42 requires counterfactual lines for top three; FR-39 allows them only where reliably calculable; top choices change later events.
guard_snippet: Define which choices are eligible (calculable method, e.g. replay with same draws) and a pre-written fallback line.
potential_consequence: The MVP ending screen shows made-up counterfactuals or can't be built.

trigger_condition: 'Save and update the cloud when idle' implies client-held state the server lacks.
guard_snippet: Remove FR-7 or name exactly what it saves, never game state or financial values.
potential_consequence: A second source of truth, sync conflicts, client tampering.

trigger_condition: Play 'on the bus' but no rule for a choice in flight when the connection drops or two devices on the same month.
guard_snippet: Choice counts only on server confirm; pending UI with idempotent retry; first confirmed wins, other device reloads with a message; offline read-only.
potential_consequence: Players on patchy connections lose choices or see conflicting states.

trigger_condition: 'Email already has a user' reveals registration; no email confirmation lets anyone register a classmate's address.
guard_snippet: Rate-limit sign-up; record the enumeration trade-off; owner can take over via reset and delete (FR-3, FR-44).
potential_consequence: Anyone can check which minors' addresses have accounts; pranks block real owners.

trigger_condition: No password policy, login throttling or reset throttling; zero-cost email quotas are small.
guard_snippet: Min password length (e.g. 8), login throttle per account and IP, reset-email limit per address and IP, same response either way.
potential_consequence: Brute-forceable minors' accounts; one script exhausts the email quota and blocks recovery for everyone.

trigger_condition: Password change/reset doesn't end other sessions; no 'log out everywhere'; OQ-5 deferred.
guard_snippet: Password change or reset ends other sessions; 'log out on all devices'; MVP session lifetime as config.
potential_consequence: A classmate makes permanent choices in someone's game on a school PC.

trigger_condition: OQ-4 (reset email at zero cost and locally) marked non-blocking, but FR-3 is MVP and self-hosted Supabase has no email by default.
guard_snippet: OQ-4 blocks FR-3 acceptance and playtests; deadline by first sprint; fallback (free SMTP relay, Mailpit locally).
potential_consequence: Testers can't reset passwords during the playtest; completion and return metrics ruined.

trigger_condition: Brief addendum's legal basis, player notice and inactive-account deletion aren't requirements; no age statement at sign-up.
guard_snippet: NFR-3: plain-Norwegian player information at sign-up, delete inactive accounts after N months, legal basis recorded; optional 'I am 15 or older'.
potential_consequence: Playtest MVP ships without basic privacy measures; minors' emails kept indefinitely.

trigger_condition: Completion and return metrics need linked game data, but NFR-3 keeps results anonymous; testers are all 18-20.
guard_snippet: Random tester code linking game and survey without email; record 18-20 as a validity limit; plan a 15-17 test with parental consent.
potential_consequence: Metrics fall back to self-report or someone breaks NFR-3; success declared on the wrong group.

trigger_condition: No hosted environment named for phone playtests; free tiers pause idle projects.
guard_snippet: NFR naming the playtest hosting (provider, tier, limits) and a keep-alive within the tier's rules.
potential_consequence: Testers returning after a week find the game paused; return and pace metrics distorted.

trigger_condition: No response-time requirement though every choice is a server round trip.
guard_snippet: NFR-10 Responsiveness: choice result within 1 s p90 on 4G, quiet-month summary within 1 s, first screen within 3 s cold.
potential_consequence: Lag hurts the 2-minute first choice and the 'feels like a game' target with nothing to point to.

trigger_condition: Web app, PWA or native, and supported browsers, not stated.
guard_snippet: State web app (PWA yes/no) and supported browsers; define 'opens or returns' for a browser tab.
potential_consequence: UX and architecture assume different platforms; FR-8 check fails when a tab stays open.

trigger_condition: 'Attempts to get around the rules' and 'invalid financial values' can't be tested as written.
guard_snippet: List the rejected cases (wrong month, option not offered, hours over rule 10, credit before 18, over limit, nonexistent item, bad amounts, replayed request ID) with stated errors.
potential_consequence: Rejection paths go untested; request-editing players skip rules.

trigger_condition: Only D1-D6 exist; new simplifications (0% family loans, moped depreciation, licences as payment, fixed card limit, no student loans, monthly hours, no interest during breaks) have no texts.
guard_snippet: Add D7+ player texts with the mechanism each belongs to.
potential_consequence: FR-40's test fails or is waived; unrealistic mechanics presented as real.

trigger_condition: New rules are promised worked examples and unit tests, but none are given.
guard_snippet: Add worked examples to the addendum: wellbeing over UJ-4's five months, each F9 ending incl. boundary, moped resale after 2 years, family loan payoff, card warning, 3x trigger with/without family loan.
potential_consequence: New engine logic is tested against whatever the developer wrote.

trigger_condition: The cut list allows 30 events while a playthrough uses 20-30 choices.
guard_snippet: Set minimum from the replay goal (e.g. 2x active months per age band) or a testable FR-43 overlap limit; raise the cut floor.
potential_consequence: Replay feels identical; 'different stories' and replay metrics fail.

trigger_condition: 'Mechanism', 'flags' and 'boomerang pair' are used as schema requirements but not defined.
guard_snippet: Glossary entries with field types for Flag, Boomerang pair and Mechanism.
potential_consequence: Authored content fails or passes the schema check with meaningless fields.

trigger_condition: FR-32's 3x bullet omits the family-loan exception stated in FR-27 and rule 8.
guard_snippet: 'total debt, not counting family loans, is above 3x the average monthly income over the last three months'.
potential_consequence: Implementing from FR-32 alone puts teenagers into a crisis for any family loan.

trigger_condition: Warning trigger ambiguous between prediction ('can't be paid in full') and event ('interest starts'); timing differs under rule 1.
guard_snippet: State exact condition and timing (e.g. card balance > current account at end of month m, shown before m+1 interest); add a test.
potential_consequence: Warning comes too late or on balances the player was about to pay.

trigger_condition: Resale start value for a new moped unclear; gift offers could reach unlicensed players; transport after sale undefined.
guard_snippet: State starting resale value for new and used, gift only with a licence, and transport cost after a sale.
potential_consequence: New moped loses half its value on day one; illegal gift ownership; selling removes all transport cost.

trigger_condition: 'The latest logged decision applies' lets any .memlog.md entry silently override the PRD; no path given.
guard_snippet: PRD is authoritative; behaviour-changing log decisions must be reflected here before downstream use; give the full path.
potential_consequence: Downstream work can't trust the PRD without auditing the log; the sensor gets conflicting sources.

trigger_condition: 'WCAG 2.x AA' names no version; room states, echo badges and moped visuals have no text alternatives.
guard_snippet: 'WCAG 2.2 level AA'; every room state and echo badge has a text equivalent; nothing by colour alone.
potential_consequence: Accessibility can't be checked; screen-reader users miss the core consequence feedback.

trigger_condition: Goal reached and wellbeing exactly equal to the threshold at age 20.
guard_snippet: if goal_reached and wellbeing >= threshold: REAL_WIN elif goal_reached: HOLLOW_WIN else: GOAL_NOT_REACHED
potential_consequence: Neither win branch matches; a player who reached the goal gets 'Goal not reached'.

location: §4.4 FR-12 with §4.5 FR-26 (rule 1 order vs rule 5)
trigger_condition: Card interest step runs before the month's choice, where the card may be paid.
guard_snippet: define card payment as its own step before the interest step, or evaluate the rule 5 paid-in-full test after the choice step
potential_consequence: Engine cannot know at the interest step whether the balance gets paid; interest misapplied.

trigger_condition: Current account cannot cover card minimum or loan instalment at the payment step.
guard_snippet: paid = min(due, available); if paid < due: mark_missed(); never overdraw for scheduled payments; define who chooses the card payment amount
potential_consequence: Undefined whether account overdraws, payment counts as missed, or both rule 8 triggers fire.

trigger_condition: Player could pay the card in full but chooses to pay less.
guard_snippet: show_warning if card_balance_after_payment > 0 at month end and previous month balance was 0, regardless of ability to pay
potential_consequence: Warning keyed to 'can't be paid' never shows; interest accrues unexplained.

trigger_condition: A rule 8 trigger stays true for many consecutive months.
guard_snippet: start one crisis per trigger episode; re-arm only after the condition has cleared or after a configured cooldown
potential_consequence: Every remaining month becomes a crisis; about 10 crisis events repeat; regular events vanish.

trigger_condition: Two or three rule 8 triggers are true at the same month end.
guard_snippet: if any(triggers): start exactly one crisis month; select crisis event by a fixed trigger priority
potential_consequence: Stacked crisis months or unclear crisis event; per-trigger F4 tests ambiguous.

trigger_condition: Crisis month falls in a month already holding a scheduled, age-unlock or boomerang event.
guard_snippet: crisis replaces that month's event and the displaced event is rescheduled to the next free month
potential_consequence: Age unlock or boomerang event silently lost, or one month carries two events.

trigger_condition: A rule 8 trigger first becomes true at the end of month 60.
guard_snippet: no random expenses in month 60, or check triggers before the final choice and run a last crisis month
potential_consequence: Loss ending from a random draw, with no crisis month to respond in.

trigger_condition: At 20, card minimum missed in months 58-59 but paid in month 60.
guard_snippet: define active per trigger: balance < 0 now; missed = last two months both missed; debt ratio evaluated now
potential_consequence: Loss versus win depends on an undefined meaning of an active miss-streak.

trigger_condition: First linked crisis choice clears all triggers, e.g. family pays in full.
guard_snippet: after each linked choice re-check triggers; end the crisis month when none remain true
potential_consequence: Player forced through remaining crisis choices, e.g. selling the moped needlessly.

trigger_condition: Player picks 'ask for a payment plan' in a crisis month.
guard_snippet: add a Rule Set v1 rule for payment plans (term, rate, instalment) with a worked example, or remove the option
potential_consequence: No rule exists, so the engine cannot compute or test the effect deterministically.

trigger_condition: Three-month average income is zero while any card or loan debt exists.
guard_snippet: handle avg_income == 0 explicitly, e.g. trigger = debt > max(3 * avg_income, configured_floor); define card status when wage ends
potential_consequence: Any card balance instantly starts a crisis, every month, after a job ends.

trigger_condition: Moped sale, family gift, pengegave or interest lands in the income average.
guard_snippet: income_for_rule8 = wage income only (state gross or net); exclude sales, gifts, interest and loan payouts
potential_consequence: One-off cash inflates the average and suppresses or delays a debt crisis.

trigger_condition: Zero-income player takes one or several consumer loans of unbounded amount and term.
guard_snippet: require wage income as for cards; config min/max amount and term; max one active loan; define early payoff
potential_consequence: Instant crisis, or terms past 20; NFR-7 'invalid value' has no definition.

trigger_condition: Player borrows near 19 and holds the cash as savings at age 20.
guard_snippet: goal check on net position: savings - outstanding debt (including family loans) >= target
potential_consequence: Savings goal won with borrowed money, the exploit already flagged for student loans.

trigger_condition: Debt-free goal checked while a 0% family loan or card balance remains.
guard_snippet: define debt for the goal check: all loans including family loans, plus card balance at month end
potential_consequence: Goal outcome undefined, because family loans are excluded from debt elsewhere.

trigger_condition: Player buys the big experience before 20, spending the money.
guard_snippet: goal_reached = experience_purchased_by_20 or balance >= target at 20; state which
potential_consequence: Player who achieved the experience fails a balance-based check at 20.

trigger_condition: Current account below 0 while savings or BSU exceed the deficit.
guard_snippet: auto-transfer from savings before the end-of-month check, or offer a transfer; define interest on a negative balance
potential_consequence: Solvent player gets a crisis month; negative balance is a free overdraft.

trigger_condition: Under-18 player picks an option costing more than the current balance.
guard_snippet: if age < 18 and option.cost > available_funds: disable or hide the option
potential_consequence: A negative balance acts as credit before 18, bypassing rule 6.

trigger_condition: Player deposits over NOK 27,500 a year in BSU, or withdraws from BSU.
guard_snippet: reject BSU deposits above the yearly cap; define withdrawal as blocked or as losing the deduction
potential_consequence: Unlimited 5.61% savings, or BSU used as free liquidity in a crisis.

trigger_condition: Game months count from the 15th birthday, but tax uses calendar years.
guard_snippet: config start_calendar_month; tax rate by age at a defined date; map December step and summer weeks
potential_consequence: Under-17 rate, December BSU deduction and summer job timing cannot be placed.

trigger_condition: Player leaves grunnskole mid-game; weekly hour limits applied to monthly rounds.
guard_snippet: track school_status with transition month; monthly_cap = weekly_cap * configured weeks, split school and non-school weeks
potential_consequence: Wrong hour cap applied, or the limit check is impossible at month granularity.

trigger_condition: Crisis offers extra shifts to a player with no job or already at the cap.
guard_snippet: offer extra_shifts only if has_job and hours < rule10_cap; otherwise omit the option
potential_consequence: Option does nothing or breaks rule 10; NFR-7 may reject an offered choice.

trigger_condition: Family loan built on the rule 4 annuity formula with r = 0.
guard_snippet: if r == 0: payment = round(P / n); final = P - payment * (n - 1)
potential_consequence: 0/0 division gives NaN instalments, or event-set instalments never reach exactly zero.

trigger_condition: Family loan offered to a player under 18.
guard_snippet: state that rule 6 covers bank credit only and family loans are allowed from 15
potential_consequence: Rule 6 'cannot borrow before 18' either blocks family loans or is broken.

trigger_condition: Player asks family again after a refusal in the same event or crisis.
guard_snippet: draw family help once per event or crisis and store it; allow one active family loan at a time
potential_consequence: Repeated draws guarantee help; stacked family loans bypass the 3x trigger.

trigger_condition: Player reloads before a random draw (expense, help, gift, event) is persisted.
guard_snippet: persist every random draw and quiet-month advance at draw time, as FR-11 does for the pengegave
potential_consequence: Player rerolls bad draws by closing and reopening the app.

trigger_condition: Gift moped offered to a player without a moped licence, or already owning one.
guard_snippet: gift_offer precondition: has_moped_licence and not owns_moped
potential_consequence: Breaks 'owning requires the licence', or two mopeds with doubled costs.

trigger_condition: Moped sold after a partial year, bought new, or held four years.
guard_snippet: value = start_price(new or used) * (1 - share) ^ years_owned, floor 0; define partial-year rounding
potential_consequence: Linear drops can go negative; new vs used start and partial years undefined.

trigger_condition: Moped repair expense or moped event drawn after the moped is sold.
guard_snippet: each expense and event carries preconditions (owns_moped, has_card, has_job) checked at draw time
potential_consequence: Player pays to repair a moped they no longer own.

trigger_condition: Boomerang follow-up would fall after month 60.
guard_snippet: schedule a follow-up only if its month <= 60; otherwise resolve it in the ending summary
potential_consequence: Promised consequence never appears; the late choice looks free.

trigger_condition: No unused age-eligible event left for an active month, e.g. library cut to 30.
guard_snippet: fallback: allow repeats after a cooldown, or turn the month into a quiet month
potential_consequence: Active month with no event, or an event repeats within a playthrough.

trigger_condition: Player owns a moped while public transport is also a fixed cost.
guard_snippet: transport = moped costs if owns_moped else public transport; prorate insurance on sale
potential_consequence: Transport charged twice, or insurance billed after the moped is sold.

trigger_condition: Player pays for the car licence before the random gift draw resolves.
guard_snippet: draw the gift at a fixed age before the paid licence is offered; never both
potential_consequence: Player pays NOK 32,500 and then also receives the gift.

trigger_condition: Wellbeing parts change without bounds; point of measurement for endings unspecified.
guard_snippet: clamp each component to [0, max]; define ending wellbeing as value at 20 or playthrough average
potential_consequence: Unbounded stress from chained crises; last-month recovery can erase four bad years.

trigger_condition: Several belongings change at once, e.g. moped sold and phone broken.
guard_snippet: room = independent layers per belonging, or a fixed priority over the handful of states
potential_consequence: Room shows wrong or stale belongings when states combine.

trigger_condition: One effect has several causes, e.g. card interest built from many purchases.
guard_snippet: cause_link = list of (choice_id or rule_id, share_in_kroner)
potential_consequence: 'Hvorfor?' and the top-three kroner ranking misattribute shared effects.

trigger_condition: Fewer than three choices have a kroner effect, or several tie.
guard_snippet: if count < 3: show fewer; tie-break by absolute effect, then earliest month
potential_consequence: Ending cannot fill three slots; ranking non-deterministic, breaking F9 tests.

location: §4.10 FR-42 (ranked by effect, tip on avoiding the problem)
trigger_condition: A top-three choice had a positive kroner effect, e.g. early saving.
guard_snippet: rank by absolute effect; positive choices get a confirming text, not an avoid-the-problem tip
potential_consequence: Player is told how a good choice's 'problem' could have been avoided.

trigger_condition: A top-three choice is not one the engine can recalculate reliably.
guard_snippet: rank only choices with computable counterfactuals, or store state at each choice for re-simulation
potential_consequence: Ending line missing or unreliable; needs earlier states the MVP doesn't store.

trigger_condition: Low wellbeing comes mostly from system causes (crisis months, hours), not one choice.
guard_snippet: define the worst wellbeing choice via wellbeing cause links; fall back to the largest system cause
potential_consequence: No valid wellbeing choice to show; the hollow-win requirement cannot be met.

trigger_condition: Player logs in again after the playthrough has ended at 20.
guard_snippet: on login with a finished playthrough: show the ending summary again with Play again
potential_consequence: Recap expects a next choice that doesn't exist; ending becomes unreachable.

trigger_condition: Player starts a new life partway through a playthrough.
guard_snippet: allow Play again only after an ending, or confirm and discard the current game explicitly
potential_consequence: Pengegave and goal rerolled at will; current game lost without warning.

trigger_condition: Sitting ends after account creation but before goal, avatar or first choice.
guard_snippet: persist onboarding step; resume at first incomplete step on login; store the pengegave when drawn
potential_consequence: Undefined landing state; pengegave may be redrawn before the first choice.

trigger_condition: Player replays or switches device after seeing a simplification text.
guard_snippet: store seen_disclosures server-side, scoped per account or per playthrough as decided
potential_consequence: Texts repeat every replay, or never reappear in a new playthrough.

trigger_condition: Someone tries to register with an email that already has a user.
guard_snippet: same response for duplicate sign-up; notify the existing owner by email instead
potential_consequence: Registration reveals which emails have accounts, undoing FR-2/FR-3 non-disclosure.

trigger_condition: Same email typed with different letter case or surrounding spaces.
guard_snippet: email = trim(lowercase(email)) before the uniqueness check, login and reset
potential_consequence: Duplicate accounts for one address, or failed logins for its owner.

trigger_condition: Player registers with someone else's address, or the same typo twice.
guard_snippet: send a notice to the address on sign-up, with a link to claim or delete the account
potential_consequence: Real owner can reset and take over the game, and cannot register.

trigger_condition: Repeated failed logins, or a trivially short password at creation.
guard_snippet: rate-limit login per account and IP; minimum password length at FR-1 and FR-4
potential_consequence: Accounts of 15-year-olds open to guessing; hashing alone doesn't prevent it.

trigger_condition: Player requests a reset several times; expiry window unspecified.
guard_snippet: a new reset request invalidates earlier links; expiry = configured value
potential_consequence: Older links stay valid; 'expires' cannot be tested without a value.

trigger_condition: Password changed, reset or account deleted while another device stays logged in.
guard_snippet: revoke all sessions on password change, reset and deletion; other devices return to login
potential_consequence: School PC session keeps access, or keeps writing to a deleted account.

trigger_condition: Two devices at the same state submit different choices for one event.
guard_snippet: each choice carries the state version; server accepts the first, rejects the second and returns fresh state
potential_consequence: Losing device's choice dropped or applied silently; no rejection UX defined.

trigger_condition: Connection drops after a choice is sent but before the server confirms.
guard_snippet: client shows a pending state, retries with the same idempotency key, shows the result only after ack
potential_consequence: Player sees a choice as made that was never saved, or vice versa.

trigger_condition: Purchase would exceed the card limit, or interest pushes the balance above it.
guard_snippet: decline purchases above the limit; allow interest above it; define over-limit consequences
potential_consequence: Card behaviour undefined at the NOK 10,000 limit that UJ-4 uses.
